title: Implement export engine
description: Implement the export engine that takes a prospect's page_data and generates a complete static HTML site bundle as a ZIP file. Uses the site template scaffold and replaces all tokens with real content.
acceptanceCriteria: Export engine accepts a prospect and returns a ZIP file buffer
ZIP contains: index.html, styles.css, scripts.js, and all referenced images
All {{token}} placeholders are replaced with real content from page_data
CSS custom properties are set with the prospect's assigned palette values
Images are inlined as relative paths within the ZIP's /images/ folder
Resulting ZIP can be unzipped and opened in a browser with full functionality
Verify by exporting a real prospect and inspecting the ZIP

steps.details: Function: `export async function generateExport(prospect: Prospect): Promise<Buffer>`. Loads template files. Replaces tokens. Fetches and embeds images. Creates ZIP. Returns buffer.

For each section in page_data, load the corresponding section HTML snippet. Replace all `{{fieldName}}` tokens with values from section content. Handle array fields (e.g., services items) by repeating the item template snippet.
Load the prospect's palette. Inject CSS custom property values into the `:root { }` block in styles.css.
Collect all image URLs from page_data. Download each image. Add to ZIP under `images/` folder. Replace image URLs in HTML with relative paths `images/{filename}`.
Use `jszip` library to create the ZIP bundle. Save to `public/exports/{slug}.zip`. Return the path as exportUrl.
Generate a full prospect. Run the export engine. Unzip and open index.html in browser. Verify all sections render with real content and images.

technicalNotes: Image downloads should use native fetch with a timeout of 10 seconds.
For images that fail to download, use a fallback placeholder image from the template.
